subject: Neighborhood Residential Zoning Ordinance Proposal
overview: The Planning and Permitting Committee met with consultants to review updated public outreach plans for citywide zoning updates and discuss draft proposals for neighborhood residential districts.

items.title: Zoning Project Timeline and Public Engagement Updates
items.summary: Innes Associates presented an updated project schedule and enhanced communications strategy, including a February 10 public Q&A meeting on Salem Street and continuing the Community Development Board's Salem Street discussion to March 5.

items.title: Neighborhood and Urban Residential Zoning Proposal
items.summary: The committee and public reviewed revised draft sub-district maps, dimensional standards, and historic conversion rules for neighborhood residential zones, focusing on aligning proposed regulations with existing built conditions without taking any formal votes.
